description: Change an issue in one call: title, body (body replaces it, append_body adds after a blank line), kind (an Issue Type, else a type:<kind> label that replaces the other type: labels), labels and assignees to add or remove (added assignees are notified), milestone or remove_milestone, and organization issue fields to set or clear. A milestone that does not exist is an error unless create_milestone is true. Issue fields, their options and values are checked before anything is written; a repository without issue fields refuses them. Needs write permission on the repository. An issue is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

add_labels.description: Labels to add; they must exist.

append_body.description: Text added after the current body, set off by a blank line.

body.description: The new body, which replaces the whole old one; empty clears it.

clear_issue_fields.description: Issue fields to clear, by name.

create_milestone.description: Create the milestone when it does not exist; needs milestone.

issue.description: The issue, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

issue_fields.description: The organization's issue fields to set, by field name (without regard to case): {"Priority": "High", "Target date": "2026-12-01"}. Each takes a text, a number, a date as YYYY-MM-DD, an option name, or a list of option names for a multi-select field.

kind.description: Such as bug: the organization's Issue Type of that name, else the type:<kind> label, replacing other type: labels.

remove_milestone.description: Take the issue out of its milestone.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_issue_edit

issue_fields.description: The issue's field values after the edit, by field name; null when issue_fields and clear_issue_fields were not given, or when the values could not be read back.

kind.description: Where the kind landed; null when none was given.

milestone.description: The milestone that was set; null when none was set or it was removed.

title: Edit a GitHub issue
